raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "b9fbd4fbb4e84c49b782df51dce8d13f::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Associate the allow rules with your Web ACL."}, {"item_id": "b9fbd4fbb4e84c49b782df51dce8d13f::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Ensure the allow rules have higher priority than blocking rules."}, {"item_id": "f283d3b175a144f79c6060c37527d667::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Verify your site in Search Console."}, {"item_id": "f283d3b175a144f79c6060c37527d667::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Verifying your site in Search Console helps you discover and diagnose potential technical issues quickly."}, {"item_id": "e1c675961d7a4e5a9970347f3564ae87::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The release date property SHOULD be set using the first known date of issuance."}, {"item_id": "2490fa631d4946eca75222b2ab6828f4::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Please reach out from an email that includes the domain you are contacting us about."}, {"item_id": "2490fa631d4946eca75222b2ab6828f4::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "It is otherwise difficult to verify reports."}, {"item_id": "e3e6c6f5a5b541778a5fa4ba0aec8f23::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Opting out of being crawled by Anthropic Bots requires modifying the robots.txt file in the manner above."}, {"item_id": "270a2b763c564b83a708e069f5536d6d::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Add `accessRights` as a free-text string."}, {"item_id": "270a2b763c564b83a708e069f5536d6d::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Add `accessRights` alongside your existing `accessLevel`."}, {"item_id": "f8610f0605044a588bd0d0f72798a874::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Use description to provide the definition of the term."}, {"item_id": "cafd293a531743f08e037b3be57c6279::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Avoid ambiguous terms."}, {"item_id": "cafd293a531743f08e037b3be57c6279::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Avoid unexplained jargon."}]}
